# Tree Cost Calculator

> Tree Cost Calculator is a free iPhone and iPad app for tree service professionals that turns a tree's circumference and height into a priced tree removal estimate, then sends it to the customer as a PDF estimate or invoice. No ads, no account, open source (GNU GPL v3). Requires iOS 17 or later. Works offline.

Key facts:
- Price per tree = starting fee + volume x rate, where volume = circumference x circumference x height / 12.56 (cubic feet, or cubic meters if you measure in meters). Example: 6 ft circumference, 50 ft height = 143.3 cu ft; at $10 per cu ft plus a $150 starting fee = $1,583.12 (example rates only; the user sets their own).
- Unlimited trees per job, each with name, measurements and photos. Trees can be entered by circumference or trunk diameter (inches or cm; the app converts diameter to circumference) and each shows its approximate diameter. Estimates can be given an optional job name (searchable, shown in the list and printed on the PDF). Other Work line items (quantity x unit price with optional minimum charge) for stump grinding per inch of diameter ("Stump grinding for <tree>" sizes it from that tree's diameter using the saved stump grinding service), trimming and pruning, haul away, crew labor, crane or bucket truck, storm work, with a saved price list.
- Additional charge and discount (dollars or percent), tax regions with tax rate and license number per state, deposit on acceptance.
- Customer signs on the phone; professional PDF estimate with logo, license number, terms, photos and signature block; one-tap convert to invoice with Invoiced and Paid status, due date, amount paid and balance due.
- Privacy: data stays on the device as files in a TCC folder in the Files app, with optional backup to the user's own iCloud Drive. The developer receives no data and uses no analytics.
- Free: no ads, no subscription, no in-app purchases.

## App
- [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760602763): iPhone and iPad, iOS 17 or later
- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/rshamilton/tcc-app): GNU GPL v3; report bugs and suggest features at https://github.com/rshamilton/tcc-app/issues
- [Home page and FAQ](https://rshamilton.github.io/treecostcalculator/): features, how the price is worked out, who it is for

## Free calculators (run in the browser, no sign-up)
- [Tree removal cost calculator](https://rshamilton.github.io/treecostcalculator/tree-removal-cost-calculator.html): price a tree from circumference, height, your rate and starting fee
- [Stump grinding cost calculator](https://rshamilton.github.io/treecostcalculator/stump-grinding-cost-calculator.html): diameter x price per inch with a minimum charge, multiple stumps
- [Tree height calculator](https://rshamilton.github.io/treecostcalculator/tree-height-calculator.html): tangent method with a phone clinometer, plus trunk diameter (DBH) from circumference
- [Firewood cord calculator](https://rshamilton.github.io/treecostcalculator/firewood-cord-calculator.html): cords, face cords and cubic meters from stack dimensions (a cord is 128 cubic feet)

- [Support](https://rshamilton.github.io/treecostcalculator/support.html): getting started, FAQ, troubleshooting, contact treecostcalculator@googlegroups.com
